about.bio:
Hi! My name is Luca.

I am from Seattle, WA and I like to make things. I am an undergraduate university student and aspiring Product Designer.

I thrive on prototyping hands-on with CAD and 3D printing, coding engaging experiences with React and SwiftUI, and bringing fun and exciting design into the products we use today.

With equal love for programming and design, I bring versatility and a Swiss army knife approach to creating technology that is accessible, natural, and fun.
